baseline.scope: only CSV inverse transform replaced inside isolated legacy worker; all other v0.4 code shared

protocol.cache: full archive pre-read; warm OS cache; independent workers
protocol.timing: restore includes internal hashes and file IO, external byte comparison excluded; range total and open/read/close spans
protocol.matching: same CSV archive for old/new decoder; all request groups paired across variants/codecs at fixed 1 MiB
protocol.order: restore/read jobs interleaved and shuffled; one restore warmup per condition
protocol.profiles: diagnostic cProfile separately before timed jobs; not used to claim speedup
protocol.memory: restore and range workers separate; legacy worker also imports frozen decoder module

zlib.basis: three cProfile calls on one transformed block; diagnostic, not a wall-time benchmark; cumulative times overlap

zstd.basis: three cProfile calls on one transformed block; diagnostic, not a wall-time benchmark; cumulative times overlap

limits: single host, one campaign, few rounds; no confidence interval or significance claim
only 32 range queries per group in default E2 trials; not a replacement for the v0.3 reading matrix
CSV v1 supports numeric LF/CRLF only; unsupported CR-only/mixed cells fall back exactly
pack executed once per profile; no new encode-speed claim
frozen legacy inverse transform is a benchmark control, not full v0.3 application timing
